CheckedUp is a healthcare media company operating a technology platform across doctor’s offices and at home. The Junior Full Stack Engineer builds and ships end-to-end product features, maintains tests and code quality, and documents software for the team.

Responsibilities
Build and ship features end to end: API endpoints and UI components, database migrations. Write REST endpoints in FastAPI or Node.js, and data access code with SQLAlchemy
Build UI in ReactJs/TailwindCSS, and internal data apps in Streamlit
Write and maintain unit and integration tests for the code you ship
Work in our monorepo; keep dependencies and scripts tidy
Efficiently use AI coding assistants to draft code, tests and documentation. Verify, Review and own the result
Fix bugs, take part in code reviews and learn from feedback
Document what you build so the next engineer can pick it up

Required
0–2 years of professional experience, or equivalent through internships, bootcamps, open source or personal projects
Working knowledge of Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, and willingness to learn
Experience with at least one front-end framework: React, Next.js
Comfort writing SQL queries and a basic understanding of relational data modeling
Familiarity with Git, pull requests and reading other people's code
Hands-on use of AI-assisted coding tools, plus the habit of checking their output before trusting it
Curiosity, clear communication and a willingness to ask questions early
Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States and must not require CheckedUp sponsorship to begin or continue employment
Preferred
Projects built with FastAPI, SQLAlchemy or Streamlit
Exposure to monorepo tools such as uv or npm workspaces
Basic Docker or CI/CD experience
Basic Cloud services (AWS, GCP, Azure)

Hybrid work in New York City
